test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Conservationists are working to do** awareness about the plight of endangered species.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**' i.e. **Raise**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "do awareness" is incorrect because the verb "do" does not collocate with the noun "awareness."
 
• The correct verb to use in this context is "**raise**," as it is commonly used with "awareness" to indicate efforts to bring attention to an issue.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4** do not fit the context and meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Conservationists are working to **raise**__ awareness about the plight of endangered species."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Create"** is incorrect because we do not "create awareness"; the collocation is not standard.
 
• **Option 3: "Build"** is incorrect because "build awareness" is less commonly used and does not fit this formal context.
 
• **Option 4: "Make"** is incorrect because "make awareness" is not a standard phrase in English.
